name: Texugo-Wind-Generator-Reloaded
title: Texugo Wind Generator Reloaded
author: Stefan Berg
description: Continuation of Texugo Wind Generator for Factorio 2.1. Original mod by Texugo Maldito. Wind generators produce free energy, but are expensive and don't have a steady output. Adds 4 tiers of turbines, from small wood generators to massive steel turbines.
